head: e3c4902e0d8786e164ea0686486c564f9dea1578
prior_evidence: 2026-10-28-m20-c4a-web-validation.json (189 reported tests preserved, not replayed as a full suite)

independent_review.findings: Stale clipboard HTML; musical prefix consumed as header; content.trim at save boundaries; PDF long-tab clipping; C4A claims exceed mocked harness
independent_review.corrections: Root implemented/finished localized fixes and targeted verification. Root also confirmed PDF font override and scroll-offset capture defects through real downloads.
independent_review.worker_handoff: mobile_contract left partial clipboard edits before quota error; dom_backend also reported quota error. Root completed the work, preserving WIP. No worker success is claimed for those failed turns.

env_review.limits: Ignored file has no tracked baseline for a historical diff. This is a current-content classification and index/ignore audit, not proof of all historical values. VITE values are client-public; retain local API configuration outside commits and verify release build environment separately.

persistence_type.c4a: MOCK / in-memory array, not durable test storage
persistence_type.proof: web/e2e/smart-chord-import.spec.ts imports installMockApi and intercepts /smart-chords with page.route/route.fulfill. setupSmartChordRoutes stores created objects in savedChords[]. Import itself synthesizes draft content instead of calling the backend.
persistence_type.c4b_pdf: Mock API supplies synthetic source; actual product html2pdf download is real
persistence_type.correction_to_prior_claim: C4A SAVE_REOPEN validates UI flow against mocks, not durable persistence. Earlier mobile C1 emulator evidence must not be substituted for Web persistence proof.

html_security.effective_path: onPaste text/html -> api.importSmartChordText(text, html) -> authenticated importTextDraft -> schema -> normalizeChordText(text, html)
html_security.actual_processing: Cheerio extracts metadata using text(); it is not an HTML sanitizer. Literal raw HTML in rawText can remain in draft.content as text.
html_security.rendering: Inspected modal/workspace/SongDetail use React text children, not injected HTML for the imported text. PDF captures that rendered DOM. No executable XSS or tenancy bypass was verified in inspected paths.
html_security.new_real_normalizer_test: PASS: HTML metadata parsed, script marker not executed, raw script tag retained as text; explicitly does not assert sanitization
html_security.prior_xss_test_limit: C4A checks an inert ClipboardEvent payload flag before sending the request, and its request is intercepted by a mock. It does not prove backend sanitization or a complete stored-XSS boundary.
html_security.not_covered: Comprehensive malformed HTML/SVG/event-handler/URL/CSS payload matrix and durable stored/reopened payload flow. Do not label this a generic XSS security PASS. Future HTML rendering requires a dedicated security boundary.

proven_fixes: Clipboard HTML invalidated on manual edit/plain paste/clipboard text replacement and workflow reset; same-event rich paste and HTML-only metadata event remain supported
Header inference limited to short nonmusical prefixes; leading chord/verse/section/tab content is normalized instead of discarded when explicit metadata occurs later
Modal and workspace send exact reviewed content at save, while trim remains only in empty-field validation
Normalizer removes boundary blank lines without trimming the first horizontal musical column; six-string indentation regression added
PDF-specific CSS keeps tablature monospaced despite selected proportional body font; fixed A4 content width and temporary uniform tab font fitting prevent clipping of long rows
html2canvas scroll origin fixed at 0,0 after actual PDF showed large initial blank space and lost tail content; final PDF includes the last verse/final line
PDF fitting restored in finally and concurrent export calls guarded

real_pdf.engine: Actual existing html2pdf.js0.10.1 through Exportar PDF -> Baixar PDF in Chrome/Playwright
real_pdf.tab_fixture: Six strings, bracketed harmonic7, 0h2, 12/14 and a deliberately long row ending19p17; original string retained in DOM and endpoint visible in exported raster
real_pdf.alignment_review: Actual page images inspected: chord anchors above lyrics, six aligned tab starts, complete long-tab endpoint, final line Fim present. Arial three-page montage and six-font first-page montage retained.
real_pdf.inspection: pdf-lib reads actual page content Do operators and extracts only each page's referenced JPEG; PIL nonwhite pixel detection checks all18 images. Visual review supplements that detector, not OCR/extracted-text proof.
real_pdf.limitations: PDF is raster-based: no embedded/searchable font/text proof. Very long tab rows fit by reducing font size and can require zoom. The final short third page contains Fim and is not blank. No universal pagination/print-engine guarantee is inferred from this fixture.

validation.backend_normalizer_affected_module: PASS - 74 tests; replay justified by changing central whitespace normalization, not full backend suite
validation.existing_c4a_browser_cases: PASS - 2 affected clipboard/save/font/transposition UI cases; API mocks remain in place

pending_for_next_session.preserve_other_wip: All existing M20C1/C2/C2D/C2E/C3, Android, workflow, billing and documentation changes remain outside C4B edits; do not reset/clean or stage repository wholesale.
pending_for_next_session.agent_ownership: Root owns final corrective diff/checkpoint; independent review completed. Prior workers failed quota and must not be assumed to have unfinished authorized edits running.

next_gate: Before an actual Web release: durable test-backend save/reload/reopen proof, explicit XSS coverage boundary and release environment config review. Android may resume from preserved C2D/E DuraSpeed evidence under its own scope; no Android action is part of this checkpoint. Review ends here.
